messages:
anya: Quick preflight for MTL region cutover (mtl1). Targeting Wed EOD for soft cutover. Need owners + blockers for KMS, DB replica, routing, egress, and canary capacity. Pinged infra/plat/sre/product above.

raj: I can own KMS + peering. Will raise the KMS key request today. Need project billing & the env tag: `redwood-prod-mtl1`.

lee: Routing ownership here — I need confirmation on policy name. Are we using `regional-canary` or a new `mtl-canary` group? Also need DNS TTL change window (prefer <60s).

miguel: Oncall/capacity: current GPU pool in mts-east can't burst to mtl. Can we reserve 2 x a10g for canary? If not we'll do smaller qps. Also need runbook updates for failover.

sam_prod: Product ok with residency. We need short FAQ for support about what qualifies as MTL-resident data. I'll draft one — need final KMS & DB owner to sign off.

anya: Action items so far: (1) raj requests KMS key & peering PR, (2) lee to confirm `mtl-canary` policy and TTL window, (3) miguel to confirm capacity numbers, (4) sam to draft FAQ. I'll track in the region-cutover board.

raj: KMS request submitted to infra-ops ticket #4321 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-4321). Peering: opening PR against `infra/peering-config` with the MTL CIDRs.

lee: I prefer `mtl-canary` so we can set different weights. Sample snippet for route rule:```yaml
- name: mtl-canary
  priority: 100
  match: region == "mtl" and user_tier == "canary"
  actions:
    - route: mtl-edge-1
      weight: 70
    - route: fallback-global
      weight: 30
```
I'll open a PR by EOD.

miguel: Capacity ask: for safe canary we want 2 x a10g (burst) + 1 x a10g reserve for failover. If procurement can't do that, we can run at 25% QPS and extend canary window to 48h. Which do you prefer?

anya: Prefer shorter window with full capacity. @raj can you confirm quota timeline?

raj: Quota request has a 48-72h lead per cloud provider. I put a note in the ticket asking expedited.

sam_prod: FAQ draft: "MTL-resident: requests routed to mtl1 where both compute & KV persist within MTL; keys are customer-managed in MTL KMS." Will post PR to docs repo once KMS key id is available.

devex-bot: Reminder: please add smoke test checklist to the PR description (see template).

lee: Small follow-up: need to update smart routing weights in `routing-config` and add a canary flag to deployments. I'll reference `deploy-bot` runbooks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout job template created: `canary-mtl-template-v1`. To trigger: `./scripts/run_canary --region mtl --template canary-mtl-template-v1`.

miguel: Also flagging DB replica lag: need cross-region replication plan. DB team — can someone confirm RPO if we spin up a read replica in mtl? cc @db-team (not in thread yet).

anya: Good call. I'll loop DB owners in the board and add them to the ticket.

lee: One more: DNS change window — recommend 90s to avoid edge caching surprises. If product wants aggressive rollback, set to 30s. Thoughts?

sam_prod: 30s for rapid rollback is better for early canary. We'll take the slight risk.

raj: noted. KMS key policy will include `rotation: disabled` during rollout window, then switch to automated rotation after 24h.

anya: Summarizing owners and deadlines: KMS & peering — raj (ticketed). Routing & PR — lee (PR by EOD). Capacity — miguel (confirm numbers & procurement lead in 24h). Product FAQ — sam (draft in 24h). DB replica — anya will add DB owners and get RPO by EOD.

sam_prod: ack :thumbsup:

lee: ack :white_check_mark:

raj: ack and will update INFRA-4321 with ETA once cloud confirms.

miguel: ack, will also prep runbook snippets for failure scenarios.

anya: I'll post the board link and set a follow-up sync tomorrow 10am PT if any blockers remain. Thanks all.

anya: (after sync) Final note: keep all PRs small and link to INFRA-4321 in descriptions. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly.
